citations.source: rocminfo inside the DCU development container
citations.locator: Agent 9-16 report Name gfx938, Marketing Name BW1101, Vendor Name C-3000, Device Type HCU, ISA amdgcn-amd-amdhsa--gfx938:sramecc+:xnack-, Wavefront Size 64, Workgroup Max Size 1024, GROUP segment 64 KiB, Compute Unit 64, SIMDs per CU 4, Max Waves Per CU 40, Max Work-item Per CU 2560; observed 2026-09-14 on bw1100

occupancy block and grid limits; gcnArchName gfx938:sramecc+:xnack-, warpSize 64, multiProcessorCount 64, regsPerBlock 131072, maxSharedMemoryPerMultiProcessor 65536, maxThreadsPerMultiProcessor 2560, maxThreadsPerBlock 1024, sharedMemPerBlock 65536, maxGridSize 2147483647 in each dimension; observed 2026-09-14 on bw1100. torch.cuda.get_device_properties reports shared_memory_per_multiprocessor 4194304 on the same device, which contradicts this API and rocminfo and is not used

Occupancy waves/SIMD for one 256-thread workgroup falls 10, 8, 4, 2, 1 as declared LDS rises 4, 8, 16, 32, 64 KiB, which confirms 64 KiB of LDS per compute unit rather than a larger per-multiprocessor budget

get_current_target() returns GPUTarget(backend='hip', arch='gfx938', warp_size=64); ahead-of-time triton.compile against that target yields the artifact roles source, ttir, ttgir, llir, amdgcn and hsaco, and no ptx or cubin
per-dispatch rows report Wave_Size 64 alongside nanosecond Start_Timestamp and End_Timestamp; no arithmetic or memory peak has been calibrated for this target, so none is declared
